scheme_name: Scheme for Interest Subvention to Nano Household Enterprises
other_conditions: Fixed capital investment must be 10 lakh rupees or less
Must comply with white or green pollution‑control category
Connected load must be 5 horsepower or less
Units listed in the negative list (e.g., photo studios, breweries, sawmills, etc.) are not eligible
benefits_summary: Provides interest subvention of 6% per annum for up to three years (8% for women and SC/ST enterprises) on term loans to eligible Nano household enterprises.
